review.summary: Auditing the tissue scaling, transport, and organ pipelines reveals discrepancies between documented and implemented dose dynamics, arbitrary single-tissue modulus scaling across all organs, hardcoded ad-hoc tissue multipliers, and inconsistent physical mappings. Outputs such as absolute Young's modulus (Pa), ejection fraction (%), pulse-wave velocity (m/s), and transport arrival times are dimensional scenario projections relative to arbitrary calibrations rather than absolute clinical predictions.

findings.title: Documentation mismatch in crosslink accumulation dose ODE
findings.evidence: README documents dose(age) as closed-form 'r·τ·(1 − e^(−age/τ))', but materials.py line 183 implements a non-linear ODE 'dd/dt = r - d / (tau * exp(alpha * d))' with exponential turnover slowing.
findings.implication: Users relying on the documented closed-form expression will miscalculate tissue dose accrual dynamics and crosslink accumulation.
findings.recommended_check: Update README.md line 56 to state the numerical feedback ODE dd/dt = r - d/(tau*exp(alpha*d)) or align tissue_dose in oxt/materials.py with the analytical formula.

findings.title: Global Young's modulus calibration anchored solely to young skin dermis
findings.evidence: S_pa is calculated as args.E_dermis_young_pa / (3 * young['G'].mean()) from skin dermis and applied globally across all tissues.
findings.implication: All tissue moduli (tendon, cartilage, myocardium, basement membrane) share a single skin-dermis conversion factor, ignoring distinct collagen concentrations, fibril densities, and volume fractions across organs.
findings.recommended_check: Calibrate tissue-specific S_pa constants based on baseline physical modulus data for each distinct tissue type.

findings.title: Uncalibrated 10x arbitrary scaling factor in myocardial stiffness input to heart model
findings.evidence: Myocardial linear modulus is scaled as 'myo.E_lin_Pa / 1e3 * 10' when passing E_myo_kpa into heart().
findings.implication: The heart organ model relies on an undocumented 10x multiplier to shift myocardial modulus into the ~10 kPa range expected by Engler optimal contractility formulas.
findings.recommended_check: Remove arbitrary scale factors and calibrate myocardial matrix baseline stiffness explicitly in LVParams or TISSUES.

findings.title: Inconsistent arterial elastance scaling relationship with PWV
findings.evidence: Code states 'Ea = p.Ea0 * pwv_ratio ** 2' with comment claiming Ea ~ PWV, but since pwv_ratio ~ sqrt(E_ratio), pwv_ratio**2 equals E_ratio directly.
findings.implication: Arterial elastance scales linearly with medial matrix modulus ratio E_ratio rather than with PWV ratio, contradicting the code comment.
findings.recommended_check: Clarify comment or modify function to reflect intended hemodynamic dependency of arterial elastance on characteristic impedance versus modulus.

findings.title: Collagen II substituted by Collagen I parameters for cartilage
findings.evidence: TISSUES['cartilage'] specifies collagen='I' and uses Col I parameters as a proxy for the Col II network.
findings.implication: Cartilage mechanics neglect specific structural differences and crosslink chemistries of collagen II networks.
findings.recommended_check: Add a Collagen II definition to COLLAGENS with appropriate mu, z, and crosslinks.

findings.title: Isotropic Poisson assumption (E = 3G) applied to anisotropic 2D networks
findings.evidence: secant_curves converts shear modulus G and stress to Young's modulus using E = 3 * G assuming ideal incompressibility.
findings.implication: For anisotropic or compressible 2D lattices, E = 3G introduces systematic conversion errors in local stiffness felt by cells.
findings.recommended_check: Calculate E directly via uniaxial stretch simulations rather than assuming 2D incompressibility (E = 3G).

review.strongest_surviving_claim: Qualitative non-linear mechanics trends, such as loss of strain-stiffening and relative network stiffening below the isostatic branching threshold z = 4 under crosslink accumulation.
review.decisive_next_experiment: Perform direct uniaxial stretching simulations of 2D/3D networks to measure E_lin and Poisson's ratio explicitly instead of scaling via E = 3G and skin-dermis calibration constants.
